summary.gate_eligibility_note: A-09 (BIL-01) and A-18 (OPS-01) are eligible for independent review on the canonical source scope. The newer main SHA does not invalidate OPS-01: its accepted criterion is exact identification of the deployed production release, which matches the frozen G1 baseline. Runtime smoke/E2E remains separately unverified.

controls.criterion: Session authentication, recovery and logout reject expired/revoked sessions in authenticated browser/API tests
controls.evidence_required: Authenticated run logs, replayable negative session fixtures

controls.criterion: Every mandatory read and mutation is authorized server-side by active membership and role, including deny tests
controls.evidence_required: Role/permission matrix plus negative API integration evidence

controls.criterion: Tenant A cannot read, mutate, export or download tenant B records via API, RLS and Storage
controls.evidence_required: Tenant A/B authenticated runtime and SQL/RLS/Storage results

controls.criterion: Privileged SQL functions, elevated writers, files and webhooks are restricted to intended principals
controls.evidence_required: Production grants/policy readback and unauthorized-invocation tests

controls.criterion: Secrets never reach client bundles or logs; TLS and at-rest protection are appropriately configured
controls.evidence_required: Secret scanner, deployed configuration attestation, transport/storage checks

controls.criterion: No known unaccepted material high/critical issue in committed flows; privileged actions have durable audit events
controls.evidence_required: Risk register, vulnerability dispositions, event replay and audit outputs

controls.criterion: A legitimate user signs up, authenticates and creates/joins the intended workspace
controls.evidence_required: Authenticated signup/onboarding E2E and durable DB readback

controls.criterion: AI inventory create/view/update and risk assessment persist with correct tenant and ownership
controls.evidence_required: Authenticated E2E plus persisted record and isolation evidence

controls.criterion: Governance workflow records accountable owner, decision, timestamps, review state and supporting evidence
controls.evidence_required: Multi-role approval/deny E2E and durable audit trail

evidence_records.result_summary: Exact read-only migration version comparison: production has 137 versions; isolated QA has 7; zero versions overlap. All 137 production versions are absent from QA and all 7 QA versions are absent from production. Canonical migration replay parity is not established.
evidence_records.reproducibility_instructions: Repeat the read-only Supabase Management API list_migrations calls for the production and isolated QA project refs, then request the production security advisors. Compare the full ordered version lists, not only counts.
limitations: Migration counts do not establish schema parity or successful replay of all canonical migrations.
Security advisor findings do not replace table-by-table policy, grants, RPC ACL and tenant-isolation tests.
No customer rows or credentials were accessed.
No database writes, migrations or destructive operations were performed.

evidence_records.result_summary: Read-only advisor snapshot: 33 INFO findings for RLS-enabled tables without policies and 1 WARN for disabled leaked-password protection. This does not establish whether each no-policy table is intentionally backend-only; table-by-table grants, FORCE RLS, RPC ACL and approved schema parity remain unverified.
evidence_records.reproducibility_instructions: Repeat the read-only production security advisor query and inspect every finding against the approved table access model, grants and RPC ACL inventory.
limitations: Advisor findings are informational/warning signals and are not a substitute for authenticated tenant isolation tests.
No customer rows or credentials were accessed.
No production settings or policies were changed.

evidence_records.test_command_or_provider_query: get_deployment(production deployment ID, withGitRepoInfo=true); list_deployments(project, target=production)
evidence_records.result_summary: Vercel reports production READY on SHA 70d3545f414d063379d481fd238aed563e05edda, which matches the frozen G1 sourceBaselineSha and the existing OPS-01 acceptance SHA. Current main is newer, but OPS-01 requires proof of the actual production deployment identity, not automatic deployment of every main commit. The new provider snapshot remains NOT_VERIFIED as independent evidence and does not establish smoke/E2E health.
evidence_records.reproducibility_instructions: Repeat Vercel get_deployment with Git repository metadata and compare the deployed commit SHA to the canonical GitHub main SHA at the same observation time.
limitations: This readback proves provider-reported deployment identity and state only.
It does not establish application runtime smoke, customer journey health or approval to deploy.
No deployment, alias, environment or production setting was changed.

evidence_records.test_command_or_provider_query: Read-only pg_catalog/pg_policies aggregate and has_table_privilege checks for public base tables
evidence_records.result_summary: Both production and isolated QA report 115/115 public base tables with RLS and FORCE RLS enabled. Each reports 33 tables without policies, but no anon or authenticated SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE grants on those no-policy tables. This narrows the advisor INFO finding but does not prove schema parity, tenant isolation, function ACL safety or service_role boundaries.
evidence_records.reproducibility_instructions: Repeat the read-only aggregate query against both Supabase project refs using pg_class, pg_namespace, pg_policies and has_table_privilege. Do not query customer rows.
limitations: Read-only catalog metadata only; no customer rows queried.
No writes, migrations, settings changes or destructive operations.
Function ACL query was not completed; function grants remain unverified.
Identical aggregate counts do not establish identical table definitions, constraints, indexes, policies or data.
Source-bound inventory only; no new provider/runtime evidence was generated by this inspection.
Existing source PASS references are preserved and are not represented as newly generated evidence.
No gate-level acceptance artifact was supplied; eligible gates are not counted as accepted.
Evidence record validation has not yet completed in CI; the three captured records are not represented as validator-passed.
